a.text: The cramped space is filled with black, which blocks out light, air and sound.
The scorching heat of Originium blocks the windpipe, preventing even a whisper from escaping.
Cold hard steel clamps down on the limbs, preventing any attempt at movement, never mind resistance.
If only tears would flow from the eyes. Mother always said tears were powerful weapons.
But the eyes are not cooperating.
They have seen too many mountains fall and too many rivers dry up over the centuries. They have seen too many loved ones die.
They have become dry, like the land after a nomadic city has passed through.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: All six power armors disabled.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Is that the last one?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Looks like it. We were delayed thirteen minutes.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Scans show a seventh!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It's headed your way, Doctor!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'll take care of it.
You did not see how Saria moved. All you know is that she was standing in front of you before you knew it.
You know she never carries a Rhine-made shield on the streets of Columbia.
She turns herself into a shield.
The enamel barrier growing from her crossed forearms blocks the power armor's attack.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Pest.
You hear Saria mutter under her breath.
That is how she views such rogue Columbian technology.
Her expression tells you what her next move is.
Saria wastes no time dealing with pests.
Her hand closes upon the chest of the power armor, where a dark hole would soon appear.
The power armor would be destroyed, or more aptly, die.
A thought comes to your mind.
She may or may not have heard more than the first syllable, but she does, in fact, stop.
It is the result of trust that you have accumulated over the course of many battles.
Her fist only scrapes the core, but the shockwave is enough to shatter the power armor's outer shell.
You see something amongst the flying metal shards that looks different.
It looks like... strands of hair.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor! Look ou—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's...
The power armor tips over.
As it further disintegrates, you see more hair, then a speck of skin, then an eye.
The eye is looking at you.
You see many emotions flash across it: anger, fear, bewilderment...
As the shell falls away completely, you realize it is begging for help.
You extend your hand.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What's happening, Myers?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I... I don't know, sir...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Let Doc Moore go.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Doc...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I can't.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Disobeying a direct order?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Why are you on their side, sir?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Didn't you say we needed to harden our hearts and do what we had to do? Didn't you say we were just their test subjects?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: This was all your idea. I... I liked Doc Moore.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I never thought you'd be the one to turn against me first.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam, maybe, or somebody else... but you, Myers, you always listened to me.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: To a fault, you said.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I listened to my boss at the plant and ended up with Oripathy. Then I started listening to you when I got here.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: You're all smart, got an education. Figured I couldn't go wrong listening to you.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: But now... we're all gonna die.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: The whitecoats are gonna kill us, Sonny! They think they got it all under control!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Search her if you don't believe me. I'm damned sure she's got a voice recorder on her. She's here to log us, and the silver monsters.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dr. Urbica, if you know a way out of this, it's time to get talking.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Elena...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia, I may not have told you the details of the experiment...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But I'll never lie to you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I never lied to you either, Sonny, Myers.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... I don't know how to deal with them.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I studied them and recorded their behavior because I wanted to solve the problem we're facing... like I said, it's part of my job.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I think Elena's telling the truth, Myers.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Would you give Joyce back to us?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Ha... haha....
The Pioneer stares at Ptilopsis. Suddenly, he raises his hand.
Silence lets out a mute cry. Her drone rams the Pioneer, sensing its master's will.
But all he did was take something from Ptilopsis's hand.
It was the treatment band that he put on her only a few hours ago.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: What... what have I done...?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Doc Moore...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: You regret it, huh? The kindness you showed me?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Someone like me doesn't deserve kindness.
The doctor returns to the side of her friends, still quiet, beautiful, pristine.
But there is no way out. This lab is a tomb, built specially for them.
There is no hope. The band is like a handcuff the company has shackled them with.
They will never find freedom, unless...
The Pioneer stuffs the medical wristband into his mouth.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Myers!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: S-Sir...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What are you doing! Spit it out, now!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The band...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It contains multiple doses of painkillers.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: His heart can't possibly take it. It'll kill him!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I've seen guys swallow these...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: They're all dead!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: The dead are the lucky ones...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Spit it out, damn you!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'll hold his jaw. Sock him in the stomach, Sam!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: One more time! I see the treatment band!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia, let's help—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Olivia?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Joyce.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: —Program start.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: She's awake?!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It's so dark...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Why is it so dark outside...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dark? But all the lights are on.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joyce... are your eyes okay?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Light.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Light... need light... warmth...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Forward...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Fearless...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Can you hear us?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She can't.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't know, but none of that sounds like Joyce.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Her condition...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know her. She's never sounded like this, before or after the operation.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You're surprised. You don't know what's happening to her.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That means the situation has long gone out of your control.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Elena... it's time to talk about these experiments.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did Dorothy...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't want to see anyone get hurt because of our work. Especially not Joyce.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Maybe you're right. We should have worked together to solve the problem.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: It's ok, Elena. No need to hesitate anymore.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: I invited all of you here. You have the right to know the truth, both Dr. Silence, and my Pioneer friends.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You were... spying on us?

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: I was concerned.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Someone needs to close the doors while you stop to talk.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You stopped the silver monsters?

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Don't call them that, Sonny.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: They can hear you.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Elena, my dear assistant, there's one more thing that I require of you.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Bring them to me.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: What you don't feel comfortable explaining, I can.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: And you know my lab is the safest.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No hostiles left outside.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: They all followed Mr. Sonny and Dr. Silence.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Communications are still out.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Looks like jamming across all standard frequencies. Mechanist might have been able to do something about it...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Mr. Sonny?
Freeze.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: That voice...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Miss Mary?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Looks like you've got a decent memory.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Why... why are you here?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Where is he?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: He... you mean Mr. Sonny?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Tell him to show himself and stop hiding behind a child like a coward!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Er, I'm a grown man...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Just barely.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Out with it, boy. Where are they?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: The Pioneers are in a building nearby...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Do you know your ears twitch when you're embarrassed?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Er... huh?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Just kidding.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: But you're a little too trusting, aren't you?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: This will go a lot easier if you tell me everything you know.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Otherwise, since you're the one who fixed the power supply, I can arrest you for obstruction of justice.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: If I can't catch the real perp, I guess you'll have to do.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No, please... don't...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I-I don't want to cause trouble for the Doctor.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then what are you waiting for? Start talking.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm not sure if you'll believe me...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: We were attacked by a bunch of silver shapeshifters, the likes of which we've never seen before.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So, she's inside.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yes. This is Dorothy's lab, and the heart of the complex.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What's the matter, Sonny?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: It's wicked stressful, getting so close to the truth.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Remember what I said, Sam. Be ready.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Can you open the door, Dr. Urbica?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: (Elena.)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (Huh?)

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: (Something feels off with the Pioneers.)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (But we've come this far.)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (You convinced me that we're all here to solve the same problem, Olivia.)

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: (I'm not so sure anymore...)

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Clock's ticking, Doctor.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Same here.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Come in, please.
Elena's hand never touched the scanner.
But the doors of the lab open to the true master of the house.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Hello, everyone.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm the Director of Rhine Lab's Originium Art Section, and the overseer of Test Site 359.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Welcome, all, to my laboratory.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So we're here at last...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam. Get her!
